quarterly_data.signal: Wacker Biotech, Wacker's wholly owned CDMO, and Eclipse Bioinnovations (Eclipsebio) announced a strategic collaboration combining Eclipsebio's AI-optimized RNA design and sequencing-based validation with Wacker Biotech's GMP-compliant manufacturing of plasmid DNA, RNA and lipid nanoparticles, supported by Wacker's newly launched contract research services, for end-to-end RNA therapeutic development.
